## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `AccessControl`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `access-control`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **AccessControl**.

## Step 2: Create a project

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev). -->
2. In the top navigation, select **Organization**.
3. On the organization overview page, select **+ Create Project**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a display name, unique name, and description for the project. Use the following values: :::info The Name field must uniquely identify your project in various contexts. The value is editable only at the time you create the project. You cannot change the name after creating the project. ::: -->
5. Select **Create**. This creates the project and opens the project home page.

## Step 3: Create a group

1. <!-- manual: In the console, go to the top navigation menu, click the Organization. -->
2. In the left navigation menu, select **Settings** under **Admin**.
3. Select **Access Control** tab and then click the **Groups**.
4. Select **+ Create Group**.
5. <!-- manual: Enter a group name and description. Use the following values: -->
6. Select **Create**.

## Step 4: Assign roles to the group

1. In the console, go to the top navigation menu, click the **Project** list, and select **Engineering Project** you created.
2. In the left navigation menu, select **Settings** under **Admin**.
3. Select **Access Control** tab and then click the **Groups**.
4. <!-- manual: On the Groups tab, search for the Engineering Project Developer group and click the corresponding edit icon. -->
5. Select **+Add Roles**.
6. In the **Add Roles to Group in Project** dialog, select **Roles** list.
7. Select **Developer**.
8. Select **Add**. This assigns the **Developer** role to the group. The mapping level appears as **Project (Engineering Project)**, indicating the scope of the mapping.
